description.zh:
服务报警配置。
> 当**PolicyNames**中配置了报警权限策略后，该配置才会生效。
description.en:
The alert configurations for the service.

> This configuration takes effect only after an alert-related access policy is configured in \`PolicyNames\`.

description.zh:
服务使用申请审批类型。可能的值：

- Manual：收到审批。

- AutoPass：自动通过。
description.en:
The approval type for service usage requests. Valid values:

- Manual: The request requires manual approval.

- AutoPass: The request is automatically approved.
The parameters for building the service.

description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. \`ClientToken\` supports only ASCII characters.
The compliance check metadata.

description.zh: 存储服务部署配置的信息。存储的信息与部署类型有关，不同的部署类型存储的数据格式不一样，因此使用JSON String格式进行数据存储。
description.en: The deployment configuration of the service. The information stored varies by deployment type. Different deployment types have different data formats. The data is stored in a JSON string.

description.zh:
部署类型。可能值：

- ros：通过ROS部署。

- terraform：通过Terraform部署。

- ack：通过ACK部署。

- spi：调用SPI部署。

- operation：代运维服务部署。
description.en:
The deployment type. Valid values:

- ros: The service is deployed using ROS.

- terraform: The service is deployed using Terraform.

- ack: The service is deployed using ACK.

- spi: The service is deployed by invoking an SPI.

- operation: The service is an O\&M service.
Specifies whether to perform a dry run to check the request.
The O\&M duration. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
是否代运维，默认为：false。可能的值：

- true：开启。

- false：关闭。
> 当**ServiceType**为**private**时需要填入该值。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable O\&M. Default value: false. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.

- false: Disabled.

> This parameter is required when \`ServiceType\` is set to \`private\`.
The license metadata.
The application log configuration.
The O\&M configuration.

description.zh: 策略名称。单个策略名称长度不超过128个字符，多个名称使用英文逗号（,）分隔。暂时只支持代运维相关参数策略。
description.en: The policy name. The name of a single policy can be up to 128 characters in length. Separate multiple names with commas (,). Only policies related to O\&M parameters are supported.
The region ID.

description.zh:
是否支持分销。可能的值：

- false：不支持。

- true：支持。
description.en:
Specifies whether the service can be distributed. Valid values:

- false: The service cannot be distributed.

- true: The service can be distributed.
The resource group ID.
The service ID.
The service details.
The information about the service agreements.
The URL of the service icon.

description.zh:
服务语言。可能的值：

- zh-CN：中文。

- en-US：英文。
description.en:
The language of the service. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English.
The detailed description of the service.
The service name.
A brief description of the service.

description.zh: 服务中用到的软件信息。
description.en: The information about the software used in the service.

description.zh:
服务类型。可能的值：

- private：部署在用户账户下的服务实例。

- managed：托管在服务商账户下的服务实例。

- operation：代运维服务实例

- poc：试用服务实例。
description.en:
The service type. Valid values:

- private: The service instance is deployed in the user's account.

- managed: The service instance is managed in the service provider's account.

- operation: An O\&M service instance.

- poc: A trial service instance.

description.zh:
共享类型。可能的值：

- Public：公开的，正式部署和试用部署都不受限。

- Restricted：受限的，正式部署和试用部署都受限。

- OnlyFormalRestricted：仅正式部署受限。

- OnlyTrailRestricted：仅试用部署受限。

- Hidden：隐藏的，不可见且不可申请部署权限。
description.en:
The sharing type. Valid values:

- Public: The service is public. Full and trial deployments are not restricted.

- Restricted: The service is restricted. Full and trial deployments are restricted.

- OnlyFormalRestricted: Only full deployments are restricted.

- OnlyTrailRestricted: Only trial deployments are restricted.

- Hidden: The service is hidden. It is not visible and you cannot request deployment permissions.
The ID of the source service for distribution.
The version of the source service for distribution.
The custom tags.
The tag key.
The tag value.

description.zh:
租户类型。可能的值：

- SingleTenant：单租户。

- MultiTenant：多租户。
description.en:
The tenant type. Valid values:

- SingleTenant: Single-tenant.

- MultiTenant: Multitenant.

description.zh: 试用时长。单位：天。试用时长的最长天数不超过30天。
description.en: The trial duration. Unit: days. The maximum trial duration is 30 days.
The upgrade metadata.
The version name.
